title: Ran my first playtest here is what I learned!!
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
So 10 days ago I posted here I was working on a new game called Poached

Here is what changed since then

* I went all in on the clay texture look & I love it.  Makes the game a lot more fun and unique  
* Added fish to the river cause its cute and funny (they swim away from you)   
* Added ways to build defensive (gates and spikes) and offensive (catapult & ladders) objects 
* Finished the HUD so it matches the rest of the site. I thought it was important that it feels familiar if you’ve played any other game on EggVerse 
* Reduced from 32 players to 24 (12 v 12 / carton v carton). it just made more sense lol  
* Conducted my first playtest with about 20 people and learned A LOT. The server got overloaded and everyone’s ping went through the roof halfway through the playtest. I rebuilt how rooms handle traffic and load-tested it with bots. So frame freezes went from 7 to 0, and worst-case ping dropped from about 150 ms to about 70 ms.     
   * if anyone has tips I'm open to hearing them! 

I got a lot feedback

* that the map was confusing, not sure if this was because of the lag and it made it hard to even explore but I'm currently redesigning the layout to make it a little simpler. 
* they didnt know they could break trees/rocks, so im adding an outline around things you can break
* they didnt know when they were being targeted, so im adding a red outline 
* too many announcements, so im reducing announcements to only bigger achievements like reaching first crack or an "omelette" (same as a penta kill & so and so forth)
* and a few others 

I'm using my grok agents to aggregate all the feedback I'm getting from players which were submitted through a variety of places so that I see 1 source. Even though AI has expedited how fast I work, I'm still heavily involved in the all details. 

Poached will be the largest game on the platform to date. It will host 24 players and will run on average 12 mins per game. The concept of Poached is simple, its like a MOBA (league/DOTA) x capture the flag typa game. 

Also another update my platform is growing!! We’re up to 1,986 game starts & 13 hours 39 minutes of recorded gameplay. This past week alone added 232 starts & 4 hours 43 minutes of playtime!!!  
  
That’s about 50% more game starts & 58% more playtime than the week before, which is insaneeeee. Seeing people spend their precious time using what I've built is the most gratifying feeling in the entire world. Still building solo (i am open to co-founders pref if you live in Toronto)
